headline: Mitsotakis: "We discuss nothing with Turkey beyond EEZ and continental shelf"
summary: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis said Greece discusses nothing with Turkey beyond the EEZ and continental shelf. He also said inflation is the biggest issue and that economic policy axes for 2027 will be presented at the TIF.
why: Greece's fiscal and inflation policies shape its government bond market, while the Thessaloniki International Fair is where it announces its economic agenda.
